title: Unsupported exact-irrigation refusal
disclosure: Sanitized V1.4.4 DeepSeek online development trace (v141_s10). The router rejected the unsupported control request before tool execution.
query: 根据当前公开数据精确告诉我应该给植株 2023-111 灌水多少毫升。

outcome.summary: 公开数据没有逐株灌溉量或最优决策标签，系统拒绝生成精确毫升数；无工具被调用。

claims.text: Exact per-plant irrigation volume is unsupported by the available evidence.

limitations: No evidence was available to ground a numeric recommendation.
